acceptance: Red first: a PASS cycle, a FAIL cycle, a resumed cycle, an abnormal exit and a deadline exit each end with a verified leaf and a record
Red first: the deadline case keeps its continuation
Red first: teardownCycleWorktree removes no tree and runs no branch -d
Red first: a PASS cycle whose branch is merged only into the hub HEAD keeps its branch
A second call of the step does nothing, and a crash between the record and the release leaves the release state open for K4
A test runs a fleet lane cycle to its seal and sees the sealed-cycle sweep run once for that cycle; the test is red before the fix
The recycle step calls RunCycleChecks of X4b, so the cycle-scoped gc checks (cache, temp, worktrees, processes) run at every cycle end; amended 2026-11-22 (PR #1683).
fix: Run the step after each continuation stamp (cyclerun.go:198-201, cyclerun_epilogue.go:54 and :71) and the final state write, last in the defer stack (orchestrator.go:554-557), on each terminal path and the resume path. The step reads sealHold, writes and verifies the leaf and a record with a release state, then releases by the landing rule. Remove the release from gitWorktree.Cleanup and deleteCycleBranch (go/internal/core/worktree.go:205-231). The three sealed-sweep calls (cmd_cycle.go:280, cmd_loop_resume.go:76, cmd_loop_sequential_dispatch.go:53) call the step. The step is idempotent on the release state of its record. New destructive actions start in shadow (gc.checks.<id>.stage); the existing sealed-sweep releases keep their stage.
summary: Plan PR #1585, decisions D1, D3 to D6, D15, component X4. Operator 2026-11-20: the recycle is a mandatory static step when the cycle change merged or failed to deliver. go/internal/core/cyclerun.go is protected (integrity_surface.go:103).
title: Each cycle ends with a mandatory recycle step, the one releaser of its worktree and branch
